description.value: You know how to work a crowd that's one bad week from rioting. When you Perform for an audience that is currently frightened, angry, or in mourning (GM's call), you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the check.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +1 to Perform is explicitly gated on the GM's own judgment call ('an audience that is currently frightened, angry, or in mourning (GM's call)') -- there is no roll option representing collective audience mood for a predicate to read.
